title: Formal Verification of Parity Obstructions and Fixed-Point Exclusions for Proper-Divisor Moments (OEIS A245211) in Lean 4
description: This eight-module Lean 4.35.0 library formalizes the proper-divisor moment a(n) = sum over proper divisors d of d * tau(d) (OEIS A245211). Basic, Dominance, Families, Parity, OmegaFour, OmegaFive, OmegaSix, and TableCerts use no external Lean packages. The only positive fixed point with Omega(n) <= 6 is 21, where Omega counts prime factors with multiplicity. OmegaFive excludes squarefree five-prime products by Cunningham forced closure. OmegaSix excludes all 11 exponent partitions of 6. Any other fixed point must be coprime to 6 and have Omega(n) >= 7. Lean also certifies the first 66 values, the minima 72 and 144 of A245213 and A245214, a(725) = 724, and uniqueness through 150. An independent Python sieve finds only 21 through 1,000,000. Its forced-closure search rejects all 14 candidate least primes for five distinct factors and all 30 for six.
notes: Mar Allen P. Sugui developed the Lean library and Python verifier with assistance from Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 4 Hydrogen. GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.1 Terra assisted with the v1.1.0 manuscript revision and release checks. The archive oeis-a245211-v1.1.0.zip includes the eight Lean modules, solver/a245211_search.py, and the paper sources. The manuscript is licensed under CC BY 4.0 and the source code under Apache 2.0.
